grain_rationale: The profile shows row_count 44721 with duplicate_row_rate 0.0, meaning no two rows are byte-identical, but neither invoice_id (distinct_count 2330) nor stock_code (distinct_count 3141) is unique on its own against the 44721 rows, so no single column can serve as a column-sourced identifier. A derived identity over invoice_id, stock_code, invoiced_at, quantity, and unit_price captures the natural transaction key: the invoice and product identify the line, the timestamp and quantity/price distinguish repeated entries of the same product within an invoice (including return lines carrying negative quantity, min -1395), and the zero duplicate_row_rate confirms this tuple is not undermined by exact-duplicate noise. This is therefore a transaction grain, one row per invoice line, with no aggregation required.

fields.name: invoice_id
fields.description: The invoice number grouping line items, sampled as sequential values like 489434-489443, with null_rate 0.0 and distinct_count 2330 well below row_count 44721 so it repeats across lines of the same invoice.

fields.name: is_cancellation
fields.description: A boolean flag over the two distinct_values false/true with null_rate 0.0, labeling whether the line represents a cancelled transaction rather than measuring a quantity.

fields.name: stock_code
fields.description: The product code sampled as alphanumeric values like 10002, 10002R, 10080, with null_rate 0.0 and distinct_count 3141, identifying which product the line refers to.

fields.name: product_description
fields.description: A free-text product label sampled as values like '12 PENCIL SMALL TUBE WOODLAND', nullable with null_rate 0.005098 (228 nulls), likely missing when a stock_code lacks a catalog description.

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: The unit count on the line, ranging from -1395 to 5184 per the profiled min/max with null_rate 0.0; negative values represent returns and the field is summed/compared across lines, making it a measure.

fields.name: invoiced_at
fields.description: The timestamp the line was invoiced, ranging 2009-12-01T07:45:00 to 2009-12-23T16:58:00 with null_rate 0.0; samples show minute-level precision with seconds always :00, so the finest resolvable grain is minute.

fields.name: unit_price
fields.description: The per-unit price on the line, ranging 0.0 to 1998.49 per the profiled min/max with null_rate 0.0, compared and multiplied across lines to compute revenue, making it a measure.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: A numeric customer identifier ranging 12346 to 18287, nullable with null_rate 0.300664 (13446 nulls), likely missing for guest or unregistered purchases; it labels the purchaser rather than measuring anything, so it is a dimension despite being numeric.

fields.name: country
fields.description: The customer's country sampled as values like Australia, Austria, Belgium, with null_rate 0.0 and distinct_count 24, categorizing the line by geography.

category_description: One row represents a single invoice line item: one product, at one quantity and unit price, invoiced to a (possibly anonymous) customer in a given country at a specific minute.
purpose: This mapping declares how the silver.silver_invoice_lines table enters the gold unified event star as the invoice_lines fact category, specifying its grain, time axis, and field roles for the deterministic modeling engine that generates the gold models from this contract.
usage: The rendered mapping contract is validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, linted, and reviewed by a human before approval; once approved, the modeling engine reads it to build the invoice_lines fact at transaction grain, keyed by the derived line_identity over invoice_id, stock_code, invoiced_at, quantity, and unit_price.
limitations: This mapping does not exclude or flag cancellation lines (is_cancellation true) or negative-quantity return lines; it leaves filtering or netting of cancellations/returns to downstream consumers. It also does not impute the 30.07% of customer_id values that are null or the 0.51% of product_description values that are null, leaving null handling to consumers of the fact.
